note: Trigger-routing suite for the merged default-orchestration-protocol pack (ADR-0020 D5 / #524, 2026-08-17): team-or-solo-rules' composition/wiring-design cases folded in alongside the original #480 fleet-protocol cases (minted from the #373 overnight campaign). Positives span both classes the merged description now owns — the six fleet-ops areas (coordination scope ladder, work-claim protocol, communication routing, version-slot/merge-order, session-death resilience, pin-race playbook) and the composition-design class (unit choice, wiring review, dispatch shape). The two negatives that used to fence each half against the other (fleet-rules' n03/n04/n10 pointing at team-or-solo-rules; team-or-solo-rules' n13 pointing at fleet-rules) are removed as self-references post-merge, not renumbered into positives — the merged suite fences only against genuinely external siblings now: parallel-work-rules (isolation decision / live collision), loop-rules (continuation timing), mobilize-chores (which tickets are mobilizable), big-change-git-rules (stacked-PR/rename git mechanics, cross-plugin), agent-writing-rules (same-plugin, encoding a delivery clause into an agent file), and harness's check-all-skills/check-all-agents/write-handoff/break-down-problem (corpus-wide sweeps and the handback contract, cross-plugin). Known accepted-leak class carried over from team-or-solo-rules (check-routing 2026-07-09): 'do my agents leverage the right skills' leaks here when check-all-agents (its owner, a user-only command) is off the model menu — benign; do not tune to chase it.
